about: What each persisted interact.json id MEANS (RELEASE_SYSTEM_REVIEW_2026-10-08 H2). Bump `meaning` and set `since` to the release that first ships the new meaning whenever the firmware changes how a saved value is read or written (packing, units, enum, range), even when interact.json does not change. `since` is a release tag with a CHANGELOG heading, or the upcoming release's tag. Baseline: earlier history is not tracked before the first release listed. tools/tau_compat.py reports an id as changed when its `since` is later than the previous release, and refuses a release whose interact.json persists an id missing here or named differently. Never reuse an id: give a new meaning a new id when the format allows it.

10.name: (internal) playback
10.what: (Player 2) word 0: bits 30-27 the layout version (0 = the legacy layout of v0.6.1 and older, where this word was the volume 0-100; 1 = the layout by area, docs/features/PERSISTENCE_LAYOUT.md), bit 26 which tuning slot was saved last (0 = A, 1 = B); the rest is reserved for playback options. A default of 1<<27 puts a fresh card on the new layout; a card saved before is migrated at the first boot

11.name: (internal) appearance
11.what: (Player 2) word 1: accent colour bits 4-0 (0-18), theme bits 10-5, polarity bit 11 (Dark 0, Light 1), font bits 14-12; before v0.7.0 this word was the accent colour alone. Bit 30 is the mark that this word is already in the new layout (a migration resumes from it); no field uses it

12.name: (internal) audio
12.what: (Player 2) word 2: volume bits 6-0 (0-100, the dB taper), repeat bits 8-7 (0 off, 1 all, 2 one), ReplayGain mode bits 10-9 (0 off, 1 track, 2 album), Halcyon EQ preset bits 15-11 (0-30); before v0.7.0 this word was the repeat mode alone. Bit 30 is the mark that this word is already in the new layout (a migration resumes from it); no field uses it

15.name: (internal) meters 1
15.what: (Player 2) word 5: the selected meter bits 5-0 (an index in the meter table), then the selected preset of meters 0-5, four bits each from bit 6; before v0.7.0 this word was the meter number alone. Bit 30 is the mark that this word is already in the new layout (a migration resumes from it); no field uses it

16.name: (internal) meters 2
16.what: (Player 2) word 6: the selected preset of meters 6-12, four bits each from bit 0; before v0.7.0 this word was the Halcyon EQ preset. Bit 30 is the mark that this word is already in the new layout (a migration resumes from it); no field uses it

20.name: (internal) tuning A 1
20.what: (Player 2) tuning slot A, word 1 of 4 (fw2/cores/tune_core.h: check byte, meter 5 bits, preset 4 bits, count 4 bits, then the parameters that differ from the preset; 31 bits per word). Since v0.7.0 the header carries a 5-bit meter number (was 3) and there are two slots (A and B): a tuning saved before is not carried over

21.name: (internal) tuning A 2
21.what: (Player 2) tuning slot A, word 2 of 4 (fw2/cores/tune_core.h: check byte, meter 5 bits, preset 4 bits, count 4 bits, then the parameters that differ from the preset; 31 bits per word). Since v0.7.0 the header carries a 5-bit meter number (was 3) and there are two slots (A and B): a tuning saved before is not carried over

22.name: (internal) tuning A 3
22.what: (Player 2) tuning slot A, word 3 of 4 (fw2/cores/tune_core.h: check byte, meter 5 bits, preset 4 bits, count 4 bits, then the parameters that differ from the preset; 31 bits per word). Since v0.7.0 the header carries a 5-bit meter number (was 3) and there are two slots (A and B): a tuning saved before is not carried over

23.name: (internal) tuning A 4
23.what: (Player 2) tuning slot A, word 4 of 4 (fw2/cores/tune_core.h: check byte, meter 5 bits, preset 4 bits, count 4 bits, then the parameters that differ from the preset; 31 bits per word). Since v0.7.0 the header carries a 5-bit meter number (was 3) and there are two slots (A and B): a tuning saved before is not carried over

27.name: (internal) tuning B 1
27.what: (Player 2) tuning slot B, word 1 of 4, same layout as slot A; the slot saved least recently is evicted. Before v0.7.0 id 27 was the theme index

28.name: (internal) tuning B 2
28.what: (Player 2) tuning slot B, word 2 of 4, same layout as slot A; the slot saved least recently is evicted. Before v0.7.0 id 28 was the theme polarity and the ReplayGain mode

29.name: (internal) tuning B 3
29.what: (Player 2) tuning slot B, word 3 of 4, same layout as slot A; the slot saved least recently is evicted. Before v0.7.0 id 29 was the meter presets, the font and the sixth meter's preset

30.name: (internal) meters 3
30.what: (Player 2) word 15: the selected preset of meters 13-19, four bits each from bit 0 (until v0.6.1 bits 3-0 were the seventh meter's preset, which is meter 6 and now lives in word 6). Bit 30 is the mark that this word is already in the new layout (a migration resumes from it); no field uses it

31.name: (internal) last played 1
31.what: (Player 2) the last played track (fw2/cores/lastplayed_core.h), word 0 of 2: record flag, queue kind, queue parent and the low ten bits of the track; 31 bits a word (an interact variable is 0..2147483647). The old player's library words (ids 24..26) are retired from interact.json (the Pocket takes at most 16 variables). First shipped in v0.7.0: the released v0.6.1 still used ids 24-26 (the old library words) for this.

32.name: (internal) last played 2
32.what: (Player 2) the last played track, word 1 of 2: a 27-bit check over word 0 and the high four bits of the track; a record that fails the check restores nothing. First shipped in v0.7.0: the released v0.6.1 still used ids 24-26 (the old library words) for this.

33.name: (internal) tuning B 4
33.what: (Player 2) tuning slot B, word 4 of 4, same layout as slot A; the slot saved least recently is evicted. Before v0.7.0 id 33 was not declared

24.name: (internal) library 1
24.what: the old player's library state, word 1 of 3; not persisted since v0.7.0 (Player 2 keeps the last played track in ids 31 and 32). An old value must be ignored.
